title: Rebuild CLAUDE.md and memory file discovery core
objective: Replace the simplified instruction-file scan with an original-equivalent memory file discovery core.
context: Go DiscoverInstructions currently walks up directories and reads a fixed candidate list.
The original has distinct Managed, User, Project, Local, AutoMem, and TeamMem concepts, with deterministic priority ordering.
This task implements the core discovery and formatting layer, leaving include/rules for task_05.
deliverables: Define MemoryFileInfo and MemoryType equivalents needed by the Go prompt package.
Load managed, user, project, and local memory files in original priority order.
Walk from root to cwd so closer project instructions appear later.
Deduplicate paths and tolerate missing files, directories, symlinks, and permission errors.
Format loaded content as original-style 'Contents of <path>...' blocks with type descriptions.
Keep DiscoverClaudeMD as a compatibility wrapper over the new implementation.
acceptance: Fixture tests cover multiple nested directories and priority order.
Missing or unreadable files never abort prompt construction.
Local/private and project/checked-in instruction descriptions are distinguishable.
Existing callers of DiscoverClaudeMD still compile.
non_goals: Do not add approval UI for external includes.
handoff_notes: Keep the data model extensible enough for task_05 to add parent, globs, rawContent, and contentDiffersFromDisk metadata.
